topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Well, if it isn’t the strangest turn of events! I was out in the field, tending to the barley, when word reached me that my own wife has been putting quill to parchment, writing down our days, our ways, like some holy scribe recording the acts of saints. What does it mean, to have one’s life turned into stories, woven into tales that might be read by others? I suppose it’s no less peculiar than the time we found a barn owl nesting in the hayloft, watching over the harvest as if it were its own clutch. I’ll have to speak with her, see what this all is about. Perhaps there’s more to our quiet life than meets the eye.
